page_title: WOL 3-1 UNI | Wolfsburg v Union Berlin 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+15' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+13' The foul by Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) was seen by Robert Schroder who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

90+12' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
90+12' Corner kick. Union Berlin will have an opportunity.
90+11' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
90+10' The ball is out of play and Union Berlin manage to earn a corner.
90+8' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+2' Daniel Bauer decides to make a substitution. Lovro Majer will be replaced by Pharell Hensel (Wolfsburg).
90+1' Substitution. Christian Eriksen walks off the pitch and Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
90+1' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom left corner, but it's not enough to beat Kamil Grabara who easily stops the effort.
90' 14 additional min. will be played.
90' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
89' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Union Berlin!

88' There's a break in play and referee Robert Schroder must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Union Berlin using VAR. This could be interesting!
88' PENALTY APPEAL by Union Berlin, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
86' The attendance is 23045.
84' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' The Union Berlin players can’t believe it after referee Robert Schroder signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

82' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Union Berlin.
82' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
79' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card.
79' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) commits a foul and Robert Schroder immediately signals a free kick.
78' Here comes a substitution. Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Stanley Nsoki.
75' The linesman signals that Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
74' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
73' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is being substituted because of an injury. Daniel Bauer sends Dzenan Pejcinovic on the pitch.
70' Here is a change. Derrick Kohn is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Tom Rothe (Union Berlin).
70' Today's match ends for Christopher Trimmel who will be replaced by Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
68' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Kamil Grabara. He makes it 3:1.
67' Now Union Berlin have a corner.
65' Daniel Bauer has decided to substitute Patrick Wimmer and he is replaced by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
64' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Wolfsburg due to an offside in the build-up play.
62' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Wolfsburg players aren’t happy.
62' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) runs on to a clever pass from Patrick Wimmer and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
59' 3 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Christian Eriksen sets up Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the top right corner. 3:0.
58' Flag up against Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
58' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' The substitution is prepared. Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Woo-Yeong Jeong.
57' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) replaces Andras Schafer.
53' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
52' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
52' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
51' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) commits a rough foul. Robert Schroder stops the game and makes a call.
50' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Daniel Bauer has made a change at the break. Jan Burger has come on in place of Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45+2' What was Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is first to react to a lofted pass from Christopher Trimmel, but fires his header miles over the bar from near the penalty spot.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
40' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
40' Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) sends a long ball in, but Kamil Grabara comfortably gathers the ball.
39' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends the corner into the box, but Kamil Grabara intercepts it and averts the threat.
39' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.
33' Derrick Kohn beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
30' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Sael Kumbedi feeds Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top right corner.
29' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
28' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Kamil Grabara.
26' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Schroder has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
25' Robert Schroder blows for a foul after Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
22' The referee has issued a yellow card to Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg).
21' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
18' Robert Schroder couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) and blew his whistle.
14' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) makes a strong challenge and Robert Schroder blows for a foul.
10' 1 - 0 Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
9' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
8' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Schroder saw the whole situation.
7' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) but poses no threat.
6' Frederik Ronnow displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

1' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
1' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Schroder interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

Wolfsburg will kick-off.
